verdict.rationale: Edge0's own README documents an official `edge0` CLI. It covers an `edge0 serve edge0-35b` subcommand exposing an OpenAI-compatible endpoint, a one-shot chat mode with `--max-new` and `--show-thinking` flags, and `--no-prerouter`/`--no-lora` switches. A macOS local CLI/daemon written in Rust is also listed. missing for 10: a dedicated CLI reference or full command list, evidence of agent-oriented CLI features (e.g. structured/JSON output), model download through the CLI itself rather than a Python script (fetch_models.py), and independent hands-on corroboration.
